name: AGC 223254 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 223254, a gas-rich dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc223254-hubble
story: A small, gas-rich dwarf galaxy first found by the hydrogen it carries, with the galaxy UGC 7603 as a neighbor within 500 kpc. Hubble resolved its red giant stars to measure its distance.

claims.text: AGC 223254 is a SHIELD II target of Hubble program 13750, 'Fundamental Parameters of the SHIELD II Galaxies'
SHIELD galaxies are gas-rich dwarf galaxies
SHIELD galaxies were selected from the ALFALFA radio (HI) survey catalog
The Hubble imaging was used to measure distances from the tip of the red giant branch
A TRGB distance was measured for AGC 223254
UGC 7603 is a neighbor galaxy within 500 kpc of AGC 223254
